scope: One additional dev-only candidate following the recorded v4 failure. No test inference, test relabeling or test rescoring.
v4_outcome: V4 fell from baseline E2E F1 0.682081 to 0.616279 and doubled model calls. Its unresolved atomicity/extra-claim errors do not justify production promotion.
baseline: The saved optimized-v1 rows from the preceding comparison; reused unchanged rather than rerun.
hypothesis: Keep the single-call compact pipeline and original extraction behavior, adding only self-contained subjects, explicit grounded arithmetic and per-claim conditional evidence checks. Clarify splitting distinct value/error predicates after v4 merged them.
dev_drivers: python-sqlite3: v4 improved self-contained entity naming and applicability evidence
sqlite-partialindex: arithmetic improves but the necessity/sufficiency gold dispute remains
python-json: v4 merged returned-value and error-behavior assertions
python-asyncio-task: v4 added the trigger but still omitted the explicit waiting segment
comparison_limitation: Sequential follow-up, not interleaved with the reused baseline. Latency/cache/service-load differences are confounded. Adaptive dev selection is exploratory, not held-out evidence.
quality_rule: Compare the same retained dev cases, excluding upstream_timeout/upstream_error and retaining all other failures. Report all-attempt results too. Require higher automatic E2E F1, no lower verdict macro-F1, and inspect targeted successes and false-supported regressions. No semantic overrides or scoring/label changes.
iteration_limit: One v5 pass, no availability retries or further candidate versions in this iteration.
production_default: compact-v1 remains unchanged pending a separately authorized evaluation decision
review_type: author self-review (AI-assisted), not independent human adjudication
